Role Overview:

The Retail Product Manager will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing retail financial products and value-added programs for automobile customers across the dealer network. - Develop and manage retail finance products such as New Car Loans, Used Car Loans, refinancing, top-up loans, buyback programs, balloon schemes, assured resale value programs, and other tailored financing structures.

- Design customer-centric value-added offerings (insurance, extended warranty finance, service package finance, accessories finance, loyalty programs).

B. Pricing, Policy & Program Management:

- Formulate product pricing, interest rate structure, schemes/subvention plans, and promotional offers.

- Build product approval notes, business cases, and policy documentation.

- Track product profitability, yield, and portfolio performance; recommend revisions to maintain competitiveness.

- Manage OEM subvention schemes and retail program rollouts across dealership networks.

- Partner with regional and field sales teams to drive product penetration and loan conversion ratios.

- Conduct product training sessions for dealer finance teams, DSA's and internal sales teams.

- Optimize dealer-level product adoption and ensure availability of proper product communication materials.
